articles.title: CFB Kingston failed environmental compliance inspection on refrigerants: memo
articles.summary: OTTAWA — Environment and Climate Change Canada warned National Defence earlier this year that the CFB Kingston base had broken federal environmental regulations by failing to test air conditioners for refrigerant leaks.

articles.title: Did Toronto actually fix Regent Park?
articles.summary: Billions spent. Thousands displaced. CBC's Igor Petrov goes inside Canada's biggest public housing experiment to see if the massive revitalization of Toronto's Regent Park is a successful blueprint for urban renewal — or a failed experiment.

articles.title: Man arrested after 2 alleged sexual assaults at Scarborough school: Toronto police
articles.summary: A 24-year-old man allegedly posed as a grade 12 student and sexually assaulted two students at a Toronto school last month, police say.

articles.title: Supreme Court to hear challenge of legislation for Ontario Place redevelopment
articles.summary: The Supreme Court of Canada plans to hear arguments Thursday from a coalition challenging the constitutionality of legislation that smooths the way for major changes at Ontario Place. The Crown and Ontario's attorney general are urging the court to dismiss the case.

articles.title: Part of DVP closed until Friday morning for demolition of building after suspicious fire: city
articles.summary: A portion of the Don Valley Parkway in Toronto's east end is closed until Friday morning for a demolition after a large blaze at an abandoned building, fire services and the city say.

articles.title: Cyclists delay province's bike lane removal start in Toronto, 2 arrested
articles.summary: Cyclists in Toronto delayed work by the province to remove bike lanes on a stretch of Bloor Street W. temporarily this week with a protest that began Tuesday evening and led to two arrests.
